title: ActionRouterCall
description: Structured JSON call emitted by the fine-tuned small model. Adapt this schema to your hackathon domain.

target.description: Element or room category from the available context menu (or 'none' if unsupported).

floor.description: Specific floor/level if mentioned (e.g. 'floor_1', 'ground'), else null.

zone.description: Specific apartment, room, or zone if mentioned, else null.
